title: The AI data center boom is colliding with cities scarred by big industry
content: National outcry against data center construction has spread to Philadelphia, where officials suggested possible construction in a neighborhood already impacted by a now-defunct oil refinery.

title: Meta now lets AI agents handle the boring parts of WhatsApp Business setup
content: A new WhatsApp Business MCP server lets developers use AI coding agents like Claude, Cursor, Codex, and ChatGPT to handle setup, messaging templates, testing, and troubleshooting.

title: The AI graveyard: a running list of projects and startups that didn’t make it
content: From Apple's repeatedly delayed Siri AI to OpenAI's messy "super app" launch, here's a look at the AI projects that shut down or missed expectations.

title: US data centers could consume more natural gas than Germany and Japan combined by 2035
content: The AI frenzy could push U.S. data centers to become one of the largest consumers of natural gas in the world.

title: AI agents now have a place to snitch
content: The AI Contact Hotline is designed to be a discreet place where agents that have witnessed misbehavior can tip off authorities.

title: Meta expands subscription push with new AI-focused plans
content: Meta One bundles expanded access to the company’s AI tools with premium features across Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp.

title: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google have been in talks on AI safety for weeks
content: OpenAI confirms weeks of AI safety talks with Anthropic and Google DeepMind, as Trump's team dismisses safety concerns and pushes to keep pace with China.

title: AEO startup Profound hits unicorn valuation, raises $180M Series D 7 months after last round
content: Profound has raised a $180 million Series D at a $1.8 billion valuation, less than seven months after it raised a $96 million Series C.

title: Former TikTok execs built an app that uses AI to teach you how to pose for a photo
content: Essentially a camera app, Superpose analyzes selfies or photos and generates four potential poses using AI.

title: Discover how to take your startup from prototype to production at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
content: Learn how to scale your startup breakthrough from prototype to production at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 with scaling leaders, Adrian Macneil (Foxglove), John Mackey (MBRYONICS), and Boris Sofman (Bedrock Robotics). Register before September 25 to save up to $200 on your pass.

title: 4 days left to exhibit at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
content: Last day to exhibit at Disrupt is Sept 18. 4 days left. Get your startup in front of 10,000+ founders, investors, operators and tech leaders October 13–15.

title: Early Anthropic hire, former METR COO have found a way to rein in rogue AI agents
content: Their startup, Artificial Intelligence Underwriting Company (AIUC) has raised $40 million in a Series A round led by Ribbit Capital, with participation from First Harmonic.

title: Salesforce and Nvidia’s new reasoning model is everything the AI labs should fear
content: Salesforce Koa is built on Nvidia's open-weight Nemotron model and is trained to do sales, marketing, and customer-support tasks.

title: Jensen Huang took a call from Trump, and showed off something else, too
content: When Jensen Huang took a live call from Trump, some of us were more focused on the phone he used to take it.
